def ticker(product: str, price: float, seq: int) -> str:
    return json.dumps({"channel": "ticker", "sequence_num": seq,
                       "events": [{"tickers": [{"product_id": product, "price": str(price)}]}]})


def test_websocket_drop_falls_back_to_rest_polling_and_a_gap_forces_a_resync(tmp_path):
    h = started(tmp_path)
    feed = TickerFeed([h.ex.futures_id], ws_factory=lambda **kw: None, clock=h.clock)
    h.rt = h.make_runtime(feed=feed)
    h.rt.startup()
    feed.on_message(ticker(h.ex.futures_id, 26_750.0, 1))  # the futures book's mid is 26_744.5
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 30)
    assert h.rt.active
    quotes = h.ex.calls.count("quote")
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 31)
    assert h.rt.prices.mode == "ws" and h.rt.prices.futures_price() == 26_750.0  # the watchdog used the fresh feed
    assert h.ex.calls.count("quote") == quotes
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 95)  # 65 s without a message: REST
    assert h.rt.prices.mode == "rest" and h.rt.prices.futures_price() == h.ex.fut_price  # the REST mid
    polls = len([c for c in h.ex.calls if c == "position"])
    feed.on_message(ticker(h.ex.futures_id, 26_750.0, 2))
    feed.on_message(ticker(h.ex.futures_id, 26_750.0, 9))  # 3..8 lost
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 96)  # a resync request polls - but at most once per 10 s: the last poll ran at +95
    assert len([c for c in h.ex.calls if c == "position"]) == polls and feed.gaps == 1 and h.rt.resync_wanted
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 105)
    assert len([c for c in h.ex.calls if c == "position"]) > polls and not h.rt.resync_wanted


def test_rate_limits_and_outages_never_stop_the_loop(tmp_path):
    h = started(tmp_path)
    h.ex.fail_next("place_market", RateLimited("429"))
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 30)
    assert h.ex.position() is None and h.journal.intent(f"ewb-e-{SIGNAL}-L")["status"] == "PENDING"
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 45)  # next poll: looked up (not there), sent again with the same id
    assert h.ex.position().contracts == 1 and h.ex.calls.count("place_market") == 2
    assert resent_only_after_a_lookup(h, "place_market") and entries(h) == [f"ewb-e-{SIGNAL}-L"]
    h.ex.fail_next("position", Unavailable("503"), times=2)
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 60)
    assert h.journal.events(kind="POLL_ERROR")
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 75)
    assert h.ex.position().contracts == 1 and h.rt.executor.trade().status == "OPEN"


def test_a_stop_move_during_a_quote_outage_goes_out_with_the_quotes(tmp_path):
    """The engine trails the stop at a close while the quotes cannot be read: the stop in force stays (no
    ratio to map the new one) and the move goes out at the first poll with quotes - never lost."""
    trail = ts("2024-03-14 07:00")  # the engine trails the long's stop at this close
    h = started(tmp_path)
    h.walk(ENTRY_BAR, trail + 3600)
    before = h.rt.executor.trade().stop_spot
    h.price(float(h.bar(trail + 3600)["open"]))
    h.ex.fail_next("quote", Unavailable("503"), times=50)
    h.at(trail + 3600 + 30)  # the cycle sees the new engine stop; every quote fails
    h.ex.clear_faults()
    assert h.rt.target.position.stop != before and h.rt.executor.trade().stop_spot == before
    h.at(trail + 3600 + 45)  # the next poll has quotes
    tr = h.rt.executor.trade()
    assert tr.stop_spot == h.rt.target.position.stop
    assert h.journal.events(kind="STOP_MOVED")[-1]["data"]["stop_spot"] == tr.stop_spot


def covered(h: Harness) -> bool:
    """Our resting brackets cover the whole position."""
    pos = h.ex.position()
    return pos is not None and sum(o.size - o.filled for o in h.ex.open_orders() if o.stop_price) >= pos.contracts


def test_a_429_storm_during_a_stop_move_keeps_the_position_protected(tmp_path):
    """Every bracket request is rate-limited while the engine trails the stop: the replacement's outcome is
    unknown (never a refusal), so the resting leg keeps protecting - it is never cancelled first - and the stop in
    force stays recorded; the move goes out at the first poll the venue answers."""
    trail = ts("2024-03-14 07:00")  # the engine trails the long's stop at this close
    h = started(tmp_path)
    h.walk(ENTRY_BAR, trail + 3600)
    before = h.rt.executor.trade().stop_spot
    h.price(float(h.bar(trail + 3600)["open"]))
    h.ex.fail_next("place_bracket", RateLimited("429"), times=50)
    t0 = trail + 3600 + 30
    for k in range(4):  # the cycle sees the new engine stop, then three polls into the storm
        h.at(t0 + 10 * k)
        assert covered(h) and h.rt.executor.trade().stop_spot == before
    assert h.journal.events(kind="BRACKET_FAILED", since=t0) and not h.journal.events(kind="LEG_GAP")
    h.ex.clear_faults()
    h.at(t0 + 40)
    tr = h.rt.executor.trade()
    assert tr.stop_spot == h.rt.target.position.stop != before
    assert [o.stop_price for o in h.ex.open_orders()] == [tr.stop_price] and covered(h)
    assert not h.journal.events(kind="UNPROTECTED", since=t0)
    # the first failed move was not replaced within 30 s: a CANARY failure (spec 6.2), entries paused
    assert [e["data"]["kind"] for e in h.journal.events(kind="ORDER_UNRESOLVED")] == ["BRACKET_FAILED"]
    assert paused(h.journal)["reason"] == "incident ORDER_UNRESOLVED"


def test_killed_in_the_middle_of_a_stop_move(tmp_path):
    """The engine trails the stop; the process dies right after the venue accepted the new TP1 leg, before the old
    one was cancelled and before the TP2 leg moved. The restart keeps the trade's resting legs, the interrupted cycle
    takes the accepted new leg over by its client order id instead of placing it again, moves the TP2 leg and
    cancels the old ones: exactly one set of legs at the new stop, the position covered all along."""
    trail = ts("2024-03-14 07:00")  # the engine trails the long's stop at this close
    h = started(tmp_path, stage="FULL", stage_days=10)
    h.walk(ENTRY_BAR, trail + 3600)
    assert legs(h) == LEGS
    h.price(float(h.bar(trail + 3600)["open"]))
    h.ex.crash_after_accept("place_bracket")
    t0 = trail + 3600 + 30
    with pytest.raises(SimCrash):
        h.at(t0)  # the cycle sees the new engine stop: the new TP1 leg is accepted, then the process dies
    resting = [o for o in h.ex.orders.values() if o.kind == "BRACKET" and o.status == "OPEN"]
    assert [(o.client_order_id.split("-")[3], o.stop_price) for o in resting] == [
        ("tp1", 26_585.0), ("tp2", 26_585.0), ("tp1", 26_620.0)] and covered(h)
    restart(h, t0 + 20)
    assert covered(h)
    for k in range(1, 4):
        h.at(t0 + 20 + 10 * k - 9)  # the interrupted cycle, then the polls
        assert covered(h)
    tr = h.rt.executor.trade()
    assert (tr.stop_spot, tr.stop_price) == (h.rt.target.position.stop, 26_620.0)
    assert legs(h) == {"tp1": (1, 27_245.0, 26_620.0), "tp2": (2, 27_610.0, 26_620.0)}
    tp1s = [o for o in h.ex.orders.values() if o.kind == "BRACKET" and o.client_order_id.split("-")[3] == "tp1"]
    assert len(tp1s) == 2 and [e["data"]["leg"] for e in h.journal.events(kind="LEG_ADOPTED", since=t0)] == ["tp1"]
    assert h.journal.events(kind="STOP_MOVED")[-1]["data"]["stop"] == 26_620.0
    assert not h.journal.events(kind="UNPROTECTED", since=t0)


def test_a_close_that_keeps_failing_keeps_the_position_protected(tmp_path):
    """The engine queues the TIME exit. The venue first refuses the close because our brackets rest on the position
    (a close conflict: they are cancelled after a session read and the close is sent again at once), then
    rate-limits it three times. After every failed close the legs are made the ones for the position again - placed
    anew after the conflict's cancel - so no poll ever finds the position unprotected, and the fifth close goes
    through with the engine's reason."""
    exit_bar = ts("2024-01-04 15:00")  # the engine queues the TIME exit at this close
    h = started(tmp_path, start=TIME_SIGNAL + 3600 + 30)
    h.at(TIME_SIGNAL + 3600 + 30)
    assert h.ex.position().side == -1
    first = legs(h)
    h.price(float(h.bar(exit_bar + 3600)["open"]))

    def conflict(cid, size=None):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]  # once; then the venue's own answers
        del h.ex.close_position
        h.ex.calls.append("close_position")
        return PlaceResult(cid, None, False, "OPEN_BRACKET_ORDERS")

    h.ex.close_position = conflict
    h.ex.fail_next("close_position", RateLimited("429"), times=3)
    t0 = exit_bar + 3600 + 30
    for k in range(3):
        h.at(t0 + 10 * k)
        assert covered(h) and legs(h) == first
    assert h.journal.events(kind="CLOSE_CONFLICT") and h.ex.calls.count("cancel") == 1  # the legs went, and came back
    h.at(t0 + 30)
    assert h.ex.position() is None and h.journal.events(kind="CLOSED")[-1]["data"]["reason"] == "TIME"
    assert len(h.journal.events(kind="CLOSE_FAILED")) == 3 and not h.journal.events(kind="UNPROTECTED", since=t0)
    assert h.ex.calls.count("close_position") == 5
    # a close not done by the next pass is a CANARY failure, recorded once for the trade's episode; the last failed
    # one was done by its next pass
    assert [e["data"]["kind"] for e in h.journal.events(kind="ORDER_UNRESOLVED")] == ["CLOSE_FAILED"]
    assert [e["data"]["kind"] for e in h.journal.events(kind="INCIDENT")] == ["ORDER_UNRESOLVED"]
    assert paused(h.journal)["reason"] == "incident ORDER_UNRESOLVED"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("ours", [True, False])
def test_an_entry_whose_answer_and_lookups_are_lost_is_protected_at_once(tmp_path, ours):
    """The entry's answer is lost and the order lookups fail for a minute while a position is there: it is protected
    from the first poll with a provisional trade from the entry's intent. Once the lookups answer it is settled -
    our entry (no incident), or, when the entry never reached the venue and the position was opened by hand, a
    foreign position (ADOPTED: a CANARY incident, entries paused)."""
    h = started(tmp_path)
    until = ENTRY_BAR + 30 + 65
    real = h.ex.find_order

    def degraded(cid, since):
        if h.clock() < until:
            h.ex.calls.append("find_order")
            raise Unavailable("503")
        return real(cid, since)

    h.ex.find_order = degraded
    if ours:
        h.ex.crash_after_accept("place_market", Unavailable("read timeout"))  # filled, the answer lost
    else:
        h.ex.fail_next("place_market", Unavailable("503"))  # never reached the venue
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 30)
    assert h.journal.intent(f"ewb-e-{SIGNAL}-L")["status"] == "PENDING"
    if not ours:
        h.ex.place_market("manual-1", 1, 1)  # the engine's long, opened by hand
    for k in range(1, 7):
        h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 30 + 10 * k)
        assert covered(h) and paused(h.journal) is None
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 30 + 70)  # the lookups answer again
    kinds = h.alerts.kinds()
    assert ("RECOVERED_ENTRY" in kinds) is ours and ("ADOPTED" in kinds) is not ours
    assert (paused(h.journal) is None) is ours and covered(h) and h.ex.calls.count("place_market") == 1 + (not ours)


def test_a_venue_refusing_new_orders_keeps_the_brackets_while_the_close_waits(tmp_path):
    """The engine queues the TIME exit while the venue takes cancels but refuses every new order (cancel-only): the
    close is refused at every poll and the brackets are never touched; it goes through once orders are taken."""
    exit_bar = ts("2024-01-04 15:00")  # the engine queues the TIME exit at this close
    h = started(tmp_path, start=TIME_SIGNAL + 3600 + 30)
    h.at(TIME_SIGNAL + 3600 + 30)
    before = sorted(o.order_id for o in h.ex.open_orders())
    h.price(float(h.bar(exit_bar + 3600)["open"]))

    def refuse(cid, *args, **kw):
        return PlaceResult(cid, None, False, "ORDER_ENTRY_DISABLED")

    h.ex.close_position = refuse
    h.ex.place_bracket = refuse
    t0 = exit_bar + 3600 + 30
    for k in range(3):
        h.at(t0 + 10 * k)
        assert sorted(o.order_id for o in h.ex.open_orders()) == before and covered(h)
    assert len(h.journal.events(kind="CLOSE_FAILED")) == 3 and "cancel" not in h.ex.calls
    del h.ex.close_position, h.ex.place_bracket
    h.at(t0 + 30)
    assert h.ex.position() is None and h.journal.events(kind="CLOSED")[-1]["data"]["reason"] == "TIME"


def test_an_exit_waits_for_the_reopen(tmp_path):
    exit_bar = ts("2024-01-04 15:00")  # the engine queues the TIME exit at this close
    h = started(tmp_path, start=TIME_SIGNAL + 3600 + 30)
    h.at(TIME_SIGNAL + 3600 + 30)
    assert h.ex.position().side == -1
    h.ex.set_session("CLOSE")
    h.price(float(h.bar(exit_bar + 3600)["open"]))
    h.at(exit_bar + 3600 + 30)  # the cycle sees the TIME exit while the session is closed
    assert h.ex.position() is not None and "CLOSE_DEFERRED" in h.alerts.kinds()
    h.ex.set_session("OPEN")
    h.at(exit_bar + 3600 + 100)  # the minute job sees OPEN and polls at once
    assert h.ex.position() is None
    assert h.journal.events(kind="CLOSED")[-1]["data"]["reason"] == "TIME"
    # the state seen at start, then every change (SHADOW gate 2 excuses only hours recorded closed)
    assert [e["data"]["state"] for e in h.journal.events(kind="SESSION")] == ["OPEN", "CLOSE", "OPEN"]


def test_an_exit_queued_before_the_cfm_halt_closes_at_the_first_open_poll(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """The engine queues LINEAGE at the Fri 16:00 New York close; the venue halts, so the close waits. The
    venue still reports the halt at the 18:00:05 minute check, so the halt bar's cycle (18:00:30) replaces
    the target before any poll sees OPEN: that target must still carry the exit, and the first poll that
    sees OPEN closes - not the next cycle an hour later (the engine's exit fills at the 18:00 open)."""
    fri16 = HALT - 3600

    class Forced(loop_mod._Run):  # type: ignore[misc, valid-type]
        def _may_enter(self, bar, t_close):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
            if bar.ts in (fri16, HALT):  # a broken lineage (the engine repeats the request while it holds)
                self._request_exit("LINEAGE")
            return super()._may_enter(bar, t_close)

    monkeypatch.setattr(loop_mod, "_Run", Forced)
    h = started(tmp_path, start=LONG_ENTRY + 30)
    h.at(LONG_ENTRY + 30)
    assert h.ex.position().side == 1
    h.ex.set_session("CLOSE")  # the CFM halt
    h.price(float(h.bar(HALT)["open"]))
    h.at(HALT + 30)  # the cycle for the Fri 16:00 bar sees the exit while the venue is halted
    assert h.rt.target.exit_queued_ts == fri16 and "CLOSE_DEFERRED" in h.alerts.kinds()
    h.price(float(h.bar(HALT + 3600)["open"]))
    h.at(HALT + 3600 + 5)  # still halted at this minute check
    assert h.ex.position() is not None
    h.ex.set_session("OPEN")
    h.at(HALT + 3600 + 30)  # the halt bar's cycle: the exit queued at 16:00 is still the target
    assert (h.rt.target.bar_ts, h.rt.target.exit_reason, h.rt.target.exit_queued_ts) == (HALT, "LINEAGE", fri16)
    h.at(HALT + 3600 + 65)  # the minute job sees OPEN and polls at once
    assert h.ex.position() is None
    assert h.journal.events(kind="CLOSED")[-1]["data"]["reason"] == "LINEAGE"


def test_a_stop_crossed_during_the_cfm_halt_closes_at_the_reopen(tmp_path):
    """Spot trades through the long's stop during the halt hour while the futures venue is closed: the engine
    stops out at the 18:00 open; the live futures reopen above the resting stop, so the bracket does not
    trigger - the halt bar's cycle closes the trade (STOP_HALT) instead of an hour later (ENGINE_FLAT)."""
    df = synth_frame()
    stop = compute_target(make_lock(df), df, HALT - 3600).position.stop  # the stop in force during the halt bar
    df.loc[df["ts"] == HALT, "low"] = stop - 10.0
    h = started(tmp_path, start=LONG_ENTRY + 30, df=df)
    h.at(LONG_ENTRY + 30)
    assert h.ex.position().side == 1
    h.ex.set_session("CLOSE")
    h.price(float(h.bar(HALT)["open"]))
    h.at(HALT + 30)
    h.price(stop - 10.0)  # nothing fills while the venue is halted
    h.at(HALT + 1800)
    assert h.ex.position() is not None and h.rt.executor.trade().status == "OPEN"
    h.price(float(h.bar(HALT + 3600)["open"]))  # the reopen, above the stop: the bracket stays
    h.ex.set_session("OPEN")
    h.at(HALT + 3600 + 30)  # minute (OPEN, nothing to close yet), then the halt bar's cycle
    assert h.rt.target.stop_pending_reopen and h.ex.position() is None
    assert h.journal.events(kind="CLOSED")[-1]["data"]["reason"] == "STOP_HALT"


class Pings:
    """healthchecks.io: GET pings and POSTed /fails, recorded."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, str, bytes | None]] = []

    def get(self, url, timeout=None):
        self.calls.append(("GET", url, None))
        return SimpleNamespace(status_code=200)

    def post(self, url, data=None, timeout=None):
        self.calls.append(("POST", url, data))
        return SimpleNamespace(status_code=200)


def test_an_account_that_stays_unreadable_with_an_open_trade_is_alerted_and_failed_out_of_band(tmp_path):
    """Final review B-1 (probe probe_unreadable): every authenticated read fails (a revoked key, a changed VPS
    address, an outage) while a CANARY trade is open - the brackets rest, but no stop move, close or gap watch
    can happen. It used to reach the user only through the next day's summary. Now: alerted within about 3
    minutes, repeats limited, healthchecks.io gets a /fail after 30 minutes, and the recovery is alerted."""
    h = started(tmp_path)
    pings = Pings()
    h.rt = h.make_runtime(heartbeat=Heartbeat("https://hc-ping.com/check", session=pings, clock=h.clock))
    h.rt.startup()
    h.at(ENTRY_BAR + 30)
    assert h.rt.executor.trade() is not None
    t0 = ENTRY_BAR + 40
    for m in ("position", "open_orders", "balance", "session", "quote", "get_order", "find_order", "key_permissions"):
        h.ex.fail_next(m, ExchangeError("HTTP 401: Unauthorized"), times=100_000)
    for k in range(1, 6 * 40):  # 40 minutes, a tick every 10 s
        h.at(t0 + 10 * k)
    seen = [(e["ts"], e["data"]) for e in h.journal.events(kind="ACCOUNT_UNREADABLE")]
    texts = [t for kind, t in h.alerts.items if kind == "ACCOUNT"]
    assert 180 <= seen[0][0] - t0 <= 250 and seen[0][1]["busy"] and len(texts) <= 6
    assert texts[0].startswith("[계좌 조회 불가]") and "HTTP 401" in texts[0] and "손절 이동" in texts[0]
    fails = [c for c in pings.calls if c[0] == "POST"]
    assert len(fails) == 1 and "Coinbase 계정 조회 불가" in fails[0][2].decode()
    assert h.journal.events(kind="ACCOUNT_UNREADABLE_FAIL")[0]["ts"] - t0 >= 1800
    h.ex.clear_faults()
    h.at(t0 + 2_460)
    assert [t for kind, t in h.alerts.items if kind == "ACCOUNT"][-1].startswith("[계좌 조회 복구]")
    assert h.journal.events(kind="ACCOUNT_READABLE") and h.ex.position() is not None

`deploy/live/.env` only fills its `${…}` settings and is never committed: `deploy/live/.gitignore`); `deploy.sh [--recover [--i-understand]] <tag>` (exit 2, nothing changed and the checkout moved back: no such tag, a tag off `origin/master`, local changes or a failing `git status`, untracked files under `src/`, `deploy/`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock` or `holdout.lock`, an image that does not build or fails its offline preflight with the service's real configuration - `EWBOT_IMAGE=<new> docker compose … run --rm --no-deps -T live preflight --offline`: the journal's stage, the secrets and key files, the user, the read-only root -, the UTC minutes 54 to 05 (a swap, its wait and a rollback with its own wait end before the hour's cycle), a flat-book check that could not read Coinbase or the journal, `--recover` not confirmed; exit 3 when not flat; then the running image is kept as `ewbot-live:previous`, the new one tagged `ewbot-live:current` and started with `EWBOT_IMAGE` pinned, and deploy.sh waits for a loop heartbeat newer than the swap from a container of the new image - every 10 s for 180 s, 600 s on a first deployment, `docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}'` of every `compose ps -q live` container must equal `docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' ewbot-live:current` (an old container left running by a failed recreate keeps heartbeating) and `exec -T live ewbot live status --json --max-age <seconds since the swap - 1>` succeed (an older heartbeat is the old runtime's) -: exit 0; a non-zero `up -d` or no such heartbeat is a failed start: with the previous checkout back, `EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:previous … run … status --json --exchange --require-flat` must pass (the new runtime may have traded), then `ewbot-live:previous` is started again and awaited the same way: exit 4 once it is up; exit 5 when it does not come up either, or when nothing is rolled back - `--recover`, a first deployment, a book the previous image did not find flat or could not read (the checkout then back on the new tag); """Static checks of deploy/live and stubbed runs of deploy.sh and backup.sh (fake git / docker / date / sleep / age /
rclone / curl on PATH: no daemon, no network)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
import yaml

import ewbot
from ewbot.live.settings import load_settings

ROOT = Path(ewbot.__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LIVE = ROOT / "deploy" / "live"
DOC = ROOT / "docs" / "live-trading.md"
COMPOSE = "docker compose -f deploy/live/docker-compose.yml"
PREV_SHA = "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111"


def test_dockerfile_pins_the_runtime_and_ships_no_secret():
    text = (LIVE / "Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert re.search(r"^FROM python:3\.12\.13-slim-bookworm@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$", text, re.M)
    assert re.search(r"^COPY --from=ghcr\.io/astral-sh/uv:0\.12\.13@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64} /uv /bin/uv$", text, re.M)
    assert text.count("uv sync --frozen --no-dev --group live") == 2
    assert "UV_NO_CACHE=1" in text  # uv's download cache never stays in a layer
    assert "python -m compileall -q /app/src" in text  # the read-only root: compiled once, at build time
    copies = re.findall(r"^COPY (?!--from)(.+)$", text, re.M)
    assert copies == ["pyproject.toml uv.lock ./", "src ./src", "holdout.lock ./"]
    # the cheap health check: the journal's loop heartbeat only, no gates
    assert "USER ewbot" in text and 'CMD ["ewbot", "live", "status", "--json", "--max-age", "180"]' in text
    assert "RUN test -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt" in text  # verified TLS needs the CA store
    assert 'ENTRYPOINT ["ewbot", "live"]' in text and 'CMD ["run"]' in text
    assert "STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM" in text  # `docker stop`: the runtime finishes its tick and exits 0
    assert not re.search(r"^ADD ", text, re.M)
    assert not any(secret in c for c in copies for secret in ("cdp_api_key", "live.env", ".env", "/etc/ewbot"))


def test_the_build_context_is_an_allowlist():
    lines = [x for x in (LIVE / "Dockerfile.dockerignore").read_text().splitlines() if x and not x.startswith("#")]
    assert lines[0] == "*" and set(lines[1:5]) == {"!pyproject.toml", "!uv.lock", "!holdout.lock", "!src/"}


def test_compose_service_restarts_mounts_secrets_read_only_and_holds_no_secret_value():
    svc = yaml.safe_load((LIVE / "docker-compose.yml").read_text())["services"]["live"]
    assert svc["restart"] == "unless-stopped" and svc["read_only"] is True and svc["user"] == "1000:1000"
    # an init as PID 1 hands SIGTERM to python, which then has time to finish its tick and flush Telegram
    assert svc["init"] is True and svc["stop_grace_period"] == "150s"
    assert svc["image"] == "${EWBOT_IMAGE:-ewbot-live:current}"
    assert set(svc["volumes"]) == {"/var/lib/ewbot:/data", "/etc/ewbot:/run/ewbot:ro"}
    env = svc["environment"]
    assert env["EWBOT_SECRETS_FILE"] == "/run/ewbot/live.env" and env["EWBOT_COINBASE_KEY_FILE"] == "/run/ewbot/cdp_api_key.json"
    assert not any(k in env for k in ("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN", "TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID", "EWBOT_GITHUB_TOKEN", "EWBOT_HEALTHCHECK_URL",
                                      "EWBOT_FUTURES_PRODUCT", "EWBOT_SPOT_PRODUCT"))
    defaults = {k: re.sub(r"^\$\{\w+:-(.*)\}$", r"\1", str(v)) for k, v in env.items()
                if k not in ("EWBOT_SECRETS_FILE", "EWBOT_COINBASE_KEY_FILE")}  # the files exist only on the VPS
    assert load_settings(defaults).paper_repo == "taejunoh/elliott-wave-btc-bot"  # every default is a valid setting
    assert svc["cap_drop"] == ["ALL"] and "no-new-privileges:true" in svc["security_opt"]
    # the journal keeps the log of the containers a deploy or a restart replaced (json-file logs go with them)
    assert svc["logging"] == {"driver": "journald", "options": {"tag": "ewbot-live"}}


def test_the_vps_settings_file_is_never_committed():
    assert "/.env" in (LIVE / ".gitignore").read_text().splitlines()  # deploy/live/.env


@pytest.mark.parametrize("script", ["deploy.sh", "backup.sh"])
def test_scripts_parse_and_fail_fast(script):
    path = LIVE / script
    assert path.read_text().splitlines()[0] == "#!/usr/bin/env bash" and "set -euo pipefail" in path.read_text()
    assert os.access(path, os.X_OK)
    assert subprocess.run(["bash", "-n", str(path)], capture_output=True).returncode == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("script", ["deploy.sh", "backup.sh"])
def test_scripts_pass_shellcheck(script):

        pytest.skip("shellcheck is not installed (apt-get install shellcheck / brew install shellcheck)")
    r = subprocess.run(["shellcheck", "--enable=check-extra-masked-returns", str(LIVE / script)],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)

def test_backup_encrypts_before_upload_and_the_timer_runs_it_daily():
    text = (LIVE / "backup.sh").read_text()
    assert text.index("ewbot live backup") < text.index("age -r") < text.index("rclone copy")
    service = (LIVE / "ewbot-backup.service").read_text()
    assert "EnvironmentFile=/etc/ewbot/backup.env" in service and "deploy/live/backup.sh" in service
    assert "TimeoutStartSec=30min" in service  # a hung run never holds back the later ones
    assert "OnCalendar=*-*-* 06:15:00 UTC" in (LIVE / "ewbot-backup.timer").read_text()


def _stub(bin_dir: Path, name: str, body: str) -> None:
    p = bin_dir / name
    p.write_text("#!/usr/bin/env bash\n" + body, encoding="utf-8")
    p.chmod(p.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC)


def run_deploy(tmp_path: Path, *args: str, on_master: bool = True, has_tag: bool = True, changes: str = "",
               untracked: str = "", status_rc: int = 0, build_rc: int = 0, preflight_rc: int = 0, flat_rc: int = 0,
               rollback_flat_rc: int = 0, minute: str = "30", current: bool = True, new_ok: bool = True,
               old_ok: bool = True, up_rc: tuple[int, ...] = (0, 0), first_up_recreates: bool = True,
               answer: str | None = None):
    """deploy.sh with stubs. The docker stub keeps the image id of every tag and the image the service's container
    runs (`sha256:old` before the deploy, none on a first deployment): `up -d` exits `up_rc[n]` and, when it succeeds
    (and `first_up_recreates` for the first one), runs ewbot-live:current. Its runtime journals fresh heartbeats when
    `new_ok` / `old_ok` - an old container that keeps running keeps heartbeating. `rollback_flat_rc`: the flat-book
    check of ewbot-live:previous before a rollback. The clock starts at 1 000 000 s and moves only with `sleep`."""
    bin_dir, st = tmp_path / "bin", tmp_path / "state"
    bin_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    st.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    log, clock = tmp_path / "calls.log", tmp_path / "clock"
    clock.write_text("1000000")
    (st / "ups").write_text("0")
    if current:
        (st / "tag_ewbot-live_current").write_text("sha256:old\n")
        (st / "container").write_text("sha256:old\n")
    _stub(bin_dir, "git", f"""echo "git $*" >> "{log}"
case "$*" in
  "rev-parse --show-toplevel") echo "{ROOT}" ;;
  "rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/tags/"*) exit {0 if has_tag else 1} ;;
  "rev-parse --verify HEAD") echo "{PREV_SHA}" ;;
  "symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD") exit 1 ;;
  "merge-base "*) exit {0 if on_master else 1} ;;
  "status --porcelain --untracked-files=no") printf '%s' "{changes}"; exit {status_rc} ;;
  "status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "*) printf '%s' "{untracked}" ;;
esac
exit 0
""")
    ups = "\n".join(f"      {i + 1}) rc={rc} ;;" for i, rc in enumerate(up_rc))
    docker = """echo "docker $*${EWBOT_IMAGE+ [EWBOT_IMAGE=$EWBOT_IMAGE]}" >> "@LOG@"
st="@ST@"
tagf() { echo "$st/tag_$(echo "$1" | tr ':/' '__')"; }
case "$*" in
  build*) [ @BUILD_RC@ -eq 0 ] || exit @BUILD_RC@; echo sha256:new > "$(tagf "${*: -2:1}")"; exit 0 ;;
  *"preflight --offline"*) exit @PREFLIGHT_RC@ ;;
  *"--require-flat"*) if [ "${EWBOT_IMAGE:-}" = ewbot-live:previous ]; then exit @ROLLBACK_FLAT_RC@; fi; exit @FLAT_RC@ ;;
  "image inspect -f {{.Id}} "*) cat "$(tagf "$5")"; exit $? ;;
  "image inspect "*) [ -f "$(tagf "$3")" ]; exit $? ;;
  "image tag "*) cp "$(tagf "$3")" "$(tagf "$4")"; exit $? ;;
  *"up -d"*)
    n=$(( $(cat "$st/ups") + 1 )); echo "$n" > "$st/ups"; rc=0
    case "$n" in
@UPS@
    esac
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && { [ "$n" -gt 1 ] || [ @RECREATES@ -eq 1 ]; }; then cp "$(tagf ewbot-live:current)" "$st/container"; fi
    exit "$rc" ;;
  *" ps -q live") if [ -f "$st/container" ]; then echo 0123cid; fi; exit 0 ;;
  "inspect -f {{.Image}} 0123cid") cat "$st/container"; exit $? ;;
  *"exec -T live ewbot live status"*)
    case "$(cat "$st/container" 2>/dev/null)" in
      sha256:new) exit @NEW_RC@ ;;
      sha256:old) exit @OLD_RC@ ;;
    esac
    exit 1 ;;
esac
exit 0
"""
    for key, value in {"@LOG@": log, "@ST@": st, "@BUILD_RC@": build_rc, "@PREFLIGHT_RC@": preflight_rc,
                       "@ROLLBACK_FLAT_RC@": rollback_flat_rc, "@FLAT_RC@": flat_rc, "@UPS@": ups,
                       "@RECREATES@": int(first_up_recreates), "@NEW_RC@": 0 if new_ok else 1,
                       "@OLD_RC@": 0 if old_ok else 1}.items():
        docker = docker.replace(key, str(value))
    _stub(bin_dir, "docker", docker)
    _stub(bin_dir, "date", f"""case "$*" in
  "-u +%M") echo "{minute}" ;;
  "+%s") cat "{clock}" ;;
  *) exec /bin/date "$@" ;;
esac
""")
    _stub(bin_dir, "sleep", f"""echo $(( $(cat "{clock}") + $1 )) > "{clock}"
""")
    env = {**os.environ, "PATH": f"{bin_dir}:{os.environ['PATH']}"}
    env.pop("EWBOT_IMAGE", None)
    stdin = {"input": answer} if answer is not None else {"stdin": subprocess.DEVNULL}  # never the terminal
    r = subprocess.run(["bash", str(LIVE / "deploy.sh"), *(args or ("v3.0.0",))], capture_output=True, text=True,
                       env=env, timeout=60, **stdin)
    calls = log.read_text().splitlines() if log.exists() else []
    return r, calls


def docker_calls(calls: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [c for c in calls if c.startswith("docker")]


def health_polls(calls: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [c for c in calls if "exec -T live ewbot live status" in c]


def image_checks(calls: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [c for c in calls if c == "docker inspect -f {{.Image}} 0123cid"]


def ups(calls: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    return [i for i, c in enumerate(calls) if " up -d " in c]


SWAP = [
    "docker image inspect ewbot-live:current",
    "docker image tag ewbot-live:current ewbot-live:previous",
    "docker image tag ewbot-live:v3.0.0 ewbot-live:current",
    "docker image inspect -f {{.Id}} ewbot-live:current",
    f"{COMPOSE} up -d --force-recreate [EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:current]",
]
# one poll: the service's container runs the image of ewbot-live:current, and it journaled a heartbeat since the swap
POLL = [f"{COMPOSE} ps -q live", "docker inspect -f {{.Image}} 0123cid",
        f"{COMPOSE} exec -T live ewbot live status --json --max-age 9"]
ROLLBACK = [
    f"git checkout --quiet --detach {PREV_SHA}",  # the previous release's compose file and scripts first
    f"{COMPOSE} run --rm --no-deps -T live status --json --exchange --require-flat [EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:previous]",
    "docker image tag ewbot-live:previous ewbot-live:current",
    "docker image inspect -f {{.Id}} ewbot-live:current",
    f"{COMPOSE} up -d --force-recreate [EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:current]",
]


def test_deploy_happy_path_checks_the_image_with_the_service_config_then_swaps_and_waits_for_the_heartbeat(tmp_path):
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    assert docker_calls(calls) == [
        "docker build --pull -f deploy/live/Dockerfile -t ewbot-live:v3.0.0 .",
        # the new image's preflight with the service's mounts, secrets, user and read-only root
        f"{COMPOSE} run --rm --no-deps -T live preflight --offline [EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:v3.0.0]",
        f"{COMPOSE} run --rm --no-deps -T live status --json --exchange --require-flat [EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:v3.0.0]",
        *SWAP,
        # only a container of the new image counts, and only a heartbeat younger than the time since the swap
        *POLL,
    ]
    assert "git checkout --quiet --detach v3.0.0" in calls and "deployed ewbot-live:v3.0.0" in r.stdout
    assert f"git checkout --quiet --detach {PREV_SHA}" not in calls  # the checkout stays at the deployed tag

    assert not any(c.startswith("git checkout") for c in calls)

def test_deploy_refuses_bad_arguments(tmp_path, args):
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, *(args or ("",)))
    assert r.returncode == 2 and "usage: deploy.sh" in r.stderr and not docker_calls(calls)


def test_deploy_rolls_back_when_the_new_runtime_writes_no_heartbeat(tmp_path):
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, new_ok=False)
    assert r.returncode == 4 and "rolled back" in r.stderr and "deployed" not in r.stdout
    polls = health_polls(calls)
    assert len(polls) == 19 and polls[17].endswith("--max-age 179")  # 3 minutes of polls, then the rollback's first
    first_up, second_up = ups(calls)
    assert calls[calls.index(polls[17]) + 1:second_up + 1] == ROLLBACK
    assert calls[second_up + 1:] == POLL


def test_deploy_never_reports_a_failed_up_as_deployed_while_the_old_container_keeps_heartbeating(tmp_path):
    """`up -d` fails and the old container keeps running and heartbeating: a failed start, never a deploy."""
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, up_rc=(1, 0))
    assert r.returncode == 4 and "up -d failed (exit 1)" in r.stderr and "deployed" not in r.stdout
    first_up, second_up = ups(calls)
    assert calls[first_up + 1:second_up + 1] == ROLLBACK  # no wait: straight to the rollback
    assert calls[second_up + 1:] == POLL


def test_deploy_waits_for_a_container_of_the_new_image_not_any_heartbeat(tmp_path):
    """`up -d` succeeds but the old container is still the one running (and heartbeating): never up."""
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, first_up_recreates=False)
    assert r.returncode == 4 and "no loop heartbeat from a container of it" in r.stderr and "deployed" not in r.stdout
    first_up, second_up = ups(calls)
    assert len(image_checks(calls[first_up:second_up])) == 18 and not health_polls(calls[first_up:second_up])
    assert calls[second_up + 1:] == POLL


@pytest.mark.parametrize("rollback_flat_rc, why", [(3, "not flat any more"), (2, "could not be checked (exit 2)")])
def test_deploy_never_rolls_back_onto_a_book_the_previous_image_does_not_find_flat(tmp_path, rollback_flat_rc, why):
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, new_ok=False, rollback_flat_rc=rollback_flat_rc)
    assert r.returncode == 5 and "not rolled back" in r.stderr and why in r.stderr
    assert len(ups(calls)) == 1 and not any("ewbot-live:previous ewbot-live:current" in c for c in calls)
    assert calls[-2:] == [ROLLBACK[1], "git checkout --quiet --detach v3.0.0"]  # the checkout of what still runs


def test_deploy_reports_a_rollback_that_does_not_come_up_either(tmp_path):
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, new_ok=False, old_ok=False)
    assert r.returncode == 5 and "not up either" in r.stderr and len(health_polls(calls)) == 36


@pytest.mark.parametrize("args, current, polls", [(("--recover", "--i-understand", "v3.0.0"), True, 18),
                                                  (("v3.0.0",), False, 60)])  # a first deployment waits 10 minutes
def test_deploy_never_rolls_back_a_recovery_or_a_first_deployment(tmp_path, args, current, polls):
    r, calls = run_deploy(tmp_path, *args, current=current, new_ok=False)
    assert r.returncode == 5 and "not rolled back" in r.stderr
    assert len(health_polls(calls)) == polls and len(ups(calls)) == 1
    assert not any("ewbot-live:previous" in c for c in calls[ups(calls)[0]:])
    assert f"git checkout --quiet --detach {PREV_SHA}" not in calls
    if not current:
        assert "docker image tag ewbot-live:current ewbot-live:previous" not in calls


def run_backup(tmp_path: Path, *, running: bool = True, rclone_rc: int = 0, ping: bool = True,
               recipient: bool = True):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / "bin"
    bin_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    data = tmp_path / "data"
    data.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    log = tmp_path / "calls.log"
    _stub(bin_dir, "docker", f"""echo "docker $*" >> "{log}"
case "$*" in
  *"ps --status running --quiet live") {"echo 0123abcd" if running else "true"} ;;
  *" backup --out /data/"*)
    last="${{@: -1}}"; out="$EWBOT_DATA_DIR/${{last#/data/}}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"; echo plain > "$out" ;;
esac
""")
    _stub(bin_dir, "age", f"""echo "age $*" >> "{log}"
test "$(cat "${{@: -1}}")" = plain || exit 1
echo sealed > "$4"
""")
    _stub(bin_dir, "rclone", f"""echo "rclone $*" >> "{log}"
test "$(cat "$2")" = sealed || exit 1
exit {rclone_rc}
""")
    _stub(bin_dir, "curl", f"""echo "curl $*" >> "{log}"
""")
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("EWBOT_")}
    env.update({"PATH": f"{bin_dir}:{os.environ['PATH']}", "EWBOT_DATA_DIR": str(data)})
    if recipient:
        env["EWBOT_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT"] = "age1examplerecipient"
    if ping:
        env["EWBOT_BACKUP_PING_URL"] = "https://hc-ping.com/backup-uuid"
    r = subprocess.run(["bash", str(LIVE / "backup.sh")], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=60)
    calls = log.read_text().splitlines() if log.exists() else []
    left = [p for p in data.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
    return r, calls, left


def pings(calls: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [re.sub(r"^curl -fsS -m 10 --retry 3 -o /dev/null --data-raw ", "", c) for c in calls if c.startswith("curl")]


def test_backup_from_the_running_service_is_encrypted_uploaded_and_reported(tmp_path):
    stale = tmp_path / "data" / "backup" / "journal-20261003T061500Z.sqlite"  # a killed run's plaintext copy
    stale.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    stale.write_text("plain")
    r, calls, left = run_backup(tmp_path)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    names = [c for c in calls if c.startswith(("docker", "age", "rclone"))]
    assert names[1].startswith(f"docker compose -f {LIVE}/docker-compose.yml exec -T live ewbot live backup --out "
                               "/data/backup/journal-")
    assert names[2].startswith("age -r age1examplerecipient -o ") and names[3].startswith("rclone copy ")
    assert names[3].endswith(".sqlite.age r2:ewbot-backups/")
    assert pings(calls) == [" https://hc-ping.com/backup-uuid/start", " https://hc-ping.com/backup-uuid"]
    assert left == []  # this run's plaintext copy and the stale one are gone


def test_backup_with_the_service_stopped_uses_a_one_off_container(tmp_path):
    r, calls, left = run_backup(tmp_path, running=False)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    assert any(c.startswith(f"docker compose -f {LIVE}/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps -T live backup --out ")
               for c in calls)
    assert not any(" exec " in c for c in calls) and left == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kw", [{"rclone_rc": 1}, {"recipient": False}])
def test_a_failed_backup_pings_fail_and_leaves_no_plaintext(tmp_path, kw):
    r, calls, left = run_backup(tmp_path, **kw)
    assert r.returncode != 0 and left == []
    assert pings(calls)[0] == " https://hc-ping.com/backup-uuid/start"
    assert pings(calls)[-1] == f"backup.sh exit {r.returncode} https://hc-ping.com/backup-uuid/fail"


def test_a_backup_without_its_check_says_nobody_is_told(tmp_path):
    r, calls, _ = run_backup(tmp_path, ping=False)
    assert r.returncode == 0 and "alerts nobody" in r.stderr and not pings(calls)

**File: `deploy/live/Dockerfile`**

```dockerfile
# ewbot live runtime (Plan 3). Built on the VPS from a tag on master by deploy/live/deploy.sh:
#   docker build -f deploy/live/Dockerfile -t ewbot-live:<tag> .
# Only pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/ and holdout.lock enter the build (Dockerfile.dockerignore); no
# secret is ever copied in: the CDP key and the secrets file are mounted read-only at run time.
# The project is installed editable at /app, so the fingerprint finds /app/src/ewbot and the
# committed /app/holdout.lock (ewbot live preflight checks both).
FROM python:3.12.13-slim-bookworm@sha256:4766d8b510c428e595d74b9cc5bbb2fae8e26316fffb4adc89908d79aacd58a2
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.13@sha256:b485bd65cc2cf1c9a93b3554012c9c3778cf7b1b5fd3d3096ce9e1226c97e1e6 /uv /bin/uv

# UV_NO_CACHE: uv's download cache (~300 MB) never stays in a layer of the image.
ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1 \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \
    UV_NO_CACHE=1 \
    UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    EWBOT_LIVE_DIR=/data \
    PATH="/app/.venv/bin:${PATH}"

WORKDIR /app
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --group live --no-install-project
COPY src ./src
COPY holdout.lock ./
# The root file system is read-only at run time: /app/src is byte-compiled here (the venv by UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE),
# else every `ewbot` process - the health check every minute included - compiles it again. The fingerprint hashes the
# *.py files only.
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --group live \
    && python -m compileall -q /app/src \
    && useradd --uid 1000 --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin ewbot \
    && mkdir -p /data \
    && chown ewbot:ewbot /data

# Verified TLS (the price feed's WebSocket checks Coinbase's certificate against the system CA store) needs
# the base image's ca-certificates: fail the build, not the feed, if a new base image lacks them.
RUN test -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

USER ewbot
# `docker stop` sends SIGTERM: `ewbot live run` finishes its current tick, stops its threads, flushes the queued
# Telegram messages and exits 0 (no [중단], no /fail). Compose runs it under an init (`init: true`) that hands the
# signal on, and its stop_grace_period leaves time for the tick and the flush.
STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM
# Unhealthy = the loop's heartbeat (journaled every minute) is older than 3 minutes: a hung loop. `--json` answers
# from the journal alone (no gates computed). Docker never restarts an unhealthy container: see the runbook.
HEALTHCHECK --interval=60s --timeout=30s --start-period=300s --retries=3 \
    CMD ["ewbot", "live", "status", "--json", "--max-age", "180"]
ENTRYPOINT ["ewbot", "live"]
CMD ["run"]
```

**File: `deploy/live/docker-compose.yml`**

```yaml
# ewbot live runtime on the VPS (docs/live-trading.md). deploy/live/deploy.sh builds ewbot-live:<tag>,
# checks it, tags it ewbot-live:current and runs `docker compose -f deploy/live/docker-compose.yml up -d`
# (with EWBOT_IMAGE pinned to ewbot-live:current). Host paths: /var/lib/ewbot (journal, candle cache, backups;
# owned by uid 1000) and /etc/ewbot (secrets, mode 700 dir / 600 files, owned by uid 1000), mounted read-only.
# deploy/live/.env (not committed: deploy/live/.gitignore) only fills the ${...} settings below - EWBOT_EXPIRY,
# EWBOT_LIVE_EDIT_STOPS, EWBOT_PAPER_REPO, EWBOT_CLOSE_CONFLICTS / EWBOT_OVERLAP_REFUSALS (refusal codes learned in
# CANARY) -; anything else written there, a secret included, never reaches the
# runtime (and would sit in a plain file: never put one there). A secret or a product added to `environment:`
# below is refused at start (ewbot.live.settings): secrets live only in /etc/ewbot, the products are fixed.
name: ewbot-live
services:
  live:
    image: ${EWBOT_IMAGE:-ewbot-live:current}
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true  # PID 1 is an init that hands SIGTERM to ewbot (python as PID 1 would not get it by default)
    user: "1000:1000"
    environment:
      EWBOT_LIVE_DIR: /data
      EWBOT_SECRETS_FILE: /run/ewbot/live.env
      EWBOT_COINBASE_KEY_FILE: /run/ewbot/cdp_api_key.json
      EWBOT_PAPER_REPO: ${EWBOT_PAPER_REPO:-taejunoh/elliott-wave-btc-bot}
      EWBOT_LIVE_EDIT_STOPS: ${EWBOT_LIVE_EDIT_STOPS:-0}
      EWBOT_EXPIRY: ${EWBOT_EXPIRY:-}
      EWBOT_CLOSE_CONFLICTS: ${EWBOT_CLOSE_CONFLICTS:-}
      EWBOT_OVERLAP_REFUSALS: ${EWBOT_OVERLAP_REFUSALS:-}
      TZ: UTC
    volumes:
      - /var/lib/ewbot:/data
      - /etc/ewbot:/run/ewbot:ro
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    stop_grace_period: 150s  # a stop finishes the current tick (at worst ~100 s: candle retries, a fill wait) + 10 s flush
    # The systemd journal keeps the log of every container, also the ones a deploy or a restart replaced
    # (`journalctl -t ewbot-live`; `docker compose ... logs live` shows the running one's); journald rotates it.
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: ewbot-live
```

**File: `deploy/live/deploy.sh`**

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Deploy a tagged master commit of ewbot's live runtime to this VPS (Plan 3 spec 5.2; docs/live-trading.md,
# "Deploying a new version"). From the repository checkout on the VPS, as the user ewbot:
#   bash deploy/live/deploy.sh <tag>              the deploy: only with a flat book
#   bash deploy/live/deploy.sh --recover <tag>    the same without the flat-book check, only to bring a runtime back
#                                                 while a position is open - a release that crash-loops, a new VPS
#                                                 after a VPS loss (runbook); asks to type "recover <tag>"
#                                                 (--i-understand instead: no question)
# Before the running runtime is touched, the new image runs its offline preflight with the service's real
# configuration (the journal's stage, the secrets and key files, the read-only root, no capabilities). The swap
# happens only outside the minutes hh:54-hh:05 UTC (a swap, its wait and a rollback with its own wait end before the
# hour's cycle at hh:00:30; entries go out until hh:05), keeps the running image as ewbot-live:previous and waits for a
# loop heartbeat from a container of the new image: 3 minutes (10 on the VPS's first deployment, which downloads the
# candle history first). A failed `up -d` or no such heartbeat is a failed start: the previous image is started
# again - only when it still finds the book flat.
# Exit codes:
#   0  deployed, the new runtime is up
#   2  refused, nothing changed: no such tag, a tag off origin/master, local changes or untracked files (src, deploy,
#      pyproject.toml, uv.lock, holdout.lock), an image that does not build or fails its preflight, the minutes
#      hh:54-hh:05 UTC, a book that could not be checked, --recover not confirmed
#   3  refused, nothing changed: not flat (an open trade, an order of unknown outcome, a standing flatten, a position or
#      a resting order)
#   4  the new runtime did not come up: rolled back, the previous image runs again and is up
#   5  the new runtime did not come up and nothing was rolled back (--recover, a first deployment, or a book the
#      previous image did not find flat), or the rolled-back previous image did not come up either: act now (runbook,
#      "Deploying a new version")
# The checkout is moved to <tag> for the build and moved back on every refusal and on a rollback.
set -euo pipefail

USAGE="usage: deploy.sh [--recover [--i-understand]] <tag>"
COMPOSE=(docker compose -f deploy/live/docker-compose.yml)
TREE=(src deploy pyproject.toml uv.lock holdout.lock)  # what the image or the deploy is made of
UP_WAIT_S=180
FIRST_UP_WAIT_S=600
MOVED=0
PREV_BRANCH=""
PREV_HEAD=""

refuse() {  # $1: why, $2: exit code (2)
  echo "refusing: $1" >&2
  exit "${2:-2}"
}

restore_checkout() {
  if [ "$MOVED" -ne 1 ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [ -n "$PREV_BRANCH" ]; then
    git checkout --quiet "$PREV_BRANCH" || echo "warning: could not check out $PREV_BRANCH again" >&2
  else
    git checkout --quiet --detach "$PREV_HEAD" || echo "warning: could not check out $PREV_HEAD again" >&2
  fi
  MOVED=0
}

on_exit() {
  local rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    restore_checkout
  fi
}

runs_image() {  # $1: an image id. 0 when the service has a container and every one runs that image
  local want="$1" cids cid have
  cids="$("${COMPOSE[@]}" ps -q live </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  if [ -z "$cids" ]; then
    return 1
  fi
  for cid in $cids; do
    have="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    if [ "$have" != "$want" ]; then
      return 1
    fi
  done
}

wait_up() {  # $1: seconds, $2: the image id. 0 once a container of that image journaled a loop heartbeat after this call
  local limit="$1" want="$2" since now elapsed
  since="$(date +%s)"
  while :; do
    sleep 10
    now="$(date +%s)"
    elapsed=$((now - since))
    # the container must be the new image's (a failed recreate leaves the old one running - and heartbeating), and
    # --max-age below the time since the swap: only a heartbeat journaled after it counts
    if runs_image "$want" \
      && "${COMPOSE[@]}" exec -T live ewbot live status --json --max-age "$((elapsed - 1))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$limit" ]; then
      return 1
    fi
  done
}

main() {
  local recover=0 confirmed=0 tag="" arg root changes untracked image minute rc answer first wait_s why want up
  for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
      --recover) recover=1 ;;
      --i-understand) confirmed=1 ;;
      -*) refuse "unknown option $arg ($USAGE)" ;;
      *) if [ -n "$tag" ]; then refuse "$USAGE"; fi; tag="$arg" ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -z "$tag" ] || { [ "$confirmed" -eq 1 ] && [ "$recover" -eq 0 ]; }; then
    refuse "$USAGE"
  fi

  root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
  cd "$root"
  git fetch --quiet --tags origin master || refuse "git fetch failed"
  git rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/tags/$tag" >/dev/null || refuse "no tag $tag"
  git merge-base --is-ancestor "$tag^{commit}" origin/master || refuse "$tag is not on origin/master"
  # a git status that fails counts as a dirty checkout
  changes="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || changes="git status failed"
  if [ -n "$changes" ]; then
    refuse "the checkout has local changes"
  fi
  untracked="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "${TREE[@]}")" || untracked="git status failed"
  if [ -n "$untracked" ]; then
    refuse "untracked files under ${TREE[*]} (they would enter the image or the deploy): remove them - git status"
  fi

  PREV_BRANCH="$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD || true)"
  PREV_HEAD="$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
  trap on_exit EXIT
  MOVED=1
  git checkout --quiet --detach "$tag"

  image="ewbot-live:$tag"
  docker build --pull -f deploy/live/Dockerfile -t "$image" . || refuse "the image $image did not build"
  # The new image's preflight with the service's real configuration, before anything runs on it.
  EWBOT_IMAGE="$image" "${COMPOSE[@]}" run --rm --no-deps -T live preflight --offline </dev/null \
    || refuse "$image failed its preflight with the service's configuration (see above)"

  if [ "$recover" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "--recover: no flat-book check - the new runtime takes over what the journal and Coinbase hold:" >&2
    EWBOT_IMAGE="$image" "${COMPOSE[@]}" run --rm --no-deps -T live status --json --exchange </dev/null \
      || echo "(the book could not be read)" >&2
    if [ "$confirmed" -eq 0 ]; then
      printf 'type "recover %s" to deploy it over the open book: ' "$tag" >&2
      answer=""
      read -r answer || true
      if [ "$answer" != "recover $tag" ]; then
        refuse "--recover not confirmed"
      fi
    fi
  fi

  # Last check before the swap: the swap, its wait and a rollback with its own wait end before the hour's cycle
  # (hh:00:30), and nothing is swapped while that cycle's entries may go out (until hh:05:00).
  minute="$(date -u +%M)"
  if [ "$((10#$minute))" -ge 54 ] || [ "$((10#$minute))" -le 5 ]; then
    refuse "it is hh:$minute UTC: no swap from hh:54 to hh:05 (the hour's cycle and its entries) - run it again from hh:06"
  fi

  if [ "$recover" -eq 0 ]; then
    # Flat book: the new image reads the live journal and asks Coinbase (the service's mounts).
    rc=0
    EWBOT_IMAGE="$image" "${COMPOSE[@]}" run --rm --no-deps -T live status --json --exchange --require-flat \
      </dev/null || rc=$?
    if [ "$rc" -eq 3 ]; then
      refuse "not flat - send /flatten in Telegram (or wait for the trade to close), then deploy again" 3
    elif [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
      refuse "could not check the book (exit $rc: Coinbase or the journal unreadable, see above) - deploy again later"
    fi
  fi

  first=1
  if docker image inspect ewbot-live:current >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker image tag ewbot-live:current ewbot-live:previous
    first=0
  fi
  docker image tag "$image" ewbot-live:current
  want="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' ewbot-live:current)"
  # EWBOT_IMAGE pinned: an EWBOT_IMAGE in deploy/live/.env never decides what runs
  up=0
  EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:current "${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d --force-recreate || up=$?
  wait_s="$UP_WAIT_S"
  if [ "$first" -eq 1 ]; then
    wait_s="$FIRST_UP_WAIT_S"
  fi
  if [ "$up" -eq 0 ] && wait_up "$wait_s" "$want"; then
    MOVED=0
    echo "deployed $image (tagged ewbot-live:current; the one before is ewbot-live:previous); follow it with: ${COMPOSE[*]} logs -f live"
    return 0
  fi
  if [ "$up" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "$image: up -d failed (exit $up) - a failed start" >&2
  else
    echo "$image: no loop heartbeat from a container of it ${wait_s}s after the start - read ${COMPOSE[*]} logs live" >&2
  fi
  if [ "$recover" -eq 1 ] || [ "$first" -eq 1 ]; then
    MOVED=0
    why="no previous image"
    if [ "$recover" -eq 1 ]; then
      why="--recover"
    fi
    echo "not rolled back ($why): $image keeps starting - fix it now (runbook, Deploying a new version)" >&2
    exit 5
  fi
  restore_checkout
  # The new runtime may have traded meanwhile: roll back only to a book the previous image still finds flat.
  rc=0
  EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:previous "${COMPOSE[@]}" run --rm --no-deps -T live status --json --exchange --require-flat \
    </dev/null || rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    git checkout --quiet --detach "$tag" || echo "warning: could not check out $tag again" >&2
    why="the book is not flat any more"
    if [ "$rc" -ne 3 ]; then
      why="the book could not be checked (exit $rc)"
    fi
    echo "not rolled back: $why - $image keeps starting: /status, the logs, then act now (runbook, Deploying a new version)" >&2
    exit 5
  fi
  docker image tag ewbot-live:previous ewbot-live:current
  want="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' ewbot-live:current)"
  up=0
  EWBOT_IMAGE=ewbot-live:current "${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d --force-recreate || up=$?
  if [ "$up" -eq 0 ] && wait_up "$UP_WAIT_S" "$want"; then
    echo "rolled back: ewbot-live:current is the previous image again and it is up ($image kept for a look)" >&2
    exit 4
  fi
  echo "the previous image is not up either - act now (runbook, Deploying a new version)" >&2
  exit 5
}

main "$@"
```

**File: `deploy/live/backup.sh`**

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Daily encrypted journal backup (Plan 3 spec 5.2), run by ewbot-backup.timer (docs/live-trading.md, "Backups").
# A consistent SQLite copy of the journal is made by the image (ewbot live backup: inside the running container, or
# in a one-off container of it when the service is stopped), encrypted with age to EWBOT_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT (the
# private key stays off the VPS) and copied with rclone to EWBOT_BACKUP_REMOTE (default r2:ewbot-backups, a
# Cloudflare R2 bucket). Every run pings its own healthchecks.io check EWBOT_BACKUP_PING_URL - /start, then success
# or /fail with the exit code -, so a backup that fails, hangs or never runs is alerted, and first removes the
# plaintext copies an earlier run could not (killed). Settings: the root-only file /etc/ewbot/backup.env (systemd's
# EnvironmentFile; never in the repository).
set -euo pipefail

PING="${EWBOT_BACKUP_PING_URL:-}"
REMOTE="${EWBOT_BACKUP_REMOTE:-r2:ewbot-backups}"
DATA="${EWBOT_DATA_DIR:-/var/lib/ewbot}"
COMPOSE=(docker compose -f "$(dirname "$0")/docker-compose.yml")
STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
NAME="journal-$STAMP.sqlite"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"

ping_check() {  # $1: "" (success), /start or /fail; $2: the body (a failure's exit code). Never fails the backup.
  if [ -n "$PING" ]; then
    curl -fsS -m 10 --retry 3 -o /dev/null --data-raw "${2:-}" "$PING$1" || echo "warning: healthchecks.io ping $1 failed" >&2
  fi
}

on_exit() {
  local rc=$?
  rm -rf "$WORK"
  rm -f "$DATA/backup/$NAME"
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "backup failed (exit $rc)" >&2
    ping_check /fail "backup.sh exit $rc"
  fi
}
trap on_exit EXIT
trap 'exit 143' TERM  # systemd's TimeoutStartSec: the EXIT trap still reports the failure

if [ -z "$PING" ]; then
  echo "warning: EWBOT_BACKUP_PING_URL is not set in /etc/ewbot/backup.env - a failed backup alerts nobody" >&2
fi
ping_check /start
# plaintext copies a killed run (SIGKILL, power loss) left behind: never kept on the VPS
rm -f -- "$DATA"/backup/journal-*.sqlite
if [ -z "${EWBOT_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT:-}" ]; then
  echo "set EWBOT_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT (an age1... public key) in /etc/ewbot/backup.env" >&2
  exit 1
fi

running="$("${COMPOSE[@]}" ps --status running --quiet live)"
if [ -n "$running" ]; then
  "${COMPOSE[@]}" exec -T live ewbot live backup --out "/data/backup/$NAME" </dev/null
else  # the service is stopped (e.g. docker compose stop live): a one-off container of the same image and mounts
  "${COMPOSE[@]}" run --rm --no-deps -T live backup --out "/data/backup/$NAME" </dev/null
fi
age -r "$EWBOT_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT" -o "$WORK/$NAME.age" "$DATA/backup/$NAME"
rclone copy "$WORK/$NAME.age" "$REMOTE/"
echo "backup uploaded: $REMOTE/$NAME.age"
ping_check ""
```

```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/ewbot-backup.service (docs/live-trading.md, "Backups"). If the runtime's user is not ewbot
# (uid 1000 was taken), change User= and the home directory in ExecStart= to that user's.
[Unit]
Description=ewbot live journal backup (encrypted, off-site)
After=docker.service
Requires=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=ewbot
# root-only (mode 600): read by systemd, not by the user or the container
EnvironmentFile=/etc/ewbot/backup.env
ExecStart=/usr/bin/bash /home/ewbot/elliott-wave-btc-bot/deploy/live/backup.sh
# a hung run is stopped (backup.sh then pings /fail) instead of holding back every later one
TimeoutStartSec=30min
```
